intro.heading: Travel Beyond the Destination
intro.body1: Ceylon Soul Travels was born from a simple belief: that travel should feel like meeting someone, not just visiting somewhere.
intro.body2: We are a team of Sri Lankan hosts, guides and storytellers who open the doors to our island — its mist-wrapped mountains, spice-laden kitchens, wild savannahs and quiet villages — with warmth, care and an eye for the details that turn a trip into a memory.

about.heroSubtitle: Born in Ceylon. Made for the world.
about.storyHeading: A Journey That Begins With People
about.storyBody1: Ceylon Soul Travels was founded by a group of friends who grew up exploring every corner of this island — from the tea-clad hills of Nuwara Eliya to the wild scrub of Yala. We wanted to share the Sri Lanka we knew: not the one in guidebooks, but the one in our memories.
about.storyBody2: Today, we design private journeys for travellers from around the world. Every itinerary is crafted by hand, every guide is a friend, and every detail is considered — because we believe travel should feel personal.
about.philosophyBody: We believe in slow travel, in taking the road less traveled, in long conversations over tea, and in the magic of arriving somewhere new and feeling instantly at home.
about.whyBody: We are not a booking platform. We are your hosts, your guides and your friends in Sri Lanka. When you travel with us, you travel with people who love this island and want you to love it too.
